notes.note: Reviewed TerminalPanel through the real public SDK TerminalSessionError constructor and shared Station failure translator. Recognized terminal error codes retain fixed direct-route, reconnect, host-update or access-refusal guidance without displaying arbitrary diagnostic messages or guessing provider credentials. Delivery classification remains uncertain without verified evidence. The restart fixture now uses the SDK refusal the actual store emits, rather than a plain Error carrying server prose that the store discards. The mounted regression preserves the ended notice and exactly one restart attempt. All 71 focused tests passed in 32.88 seconds; the final TerminalPanel file passed all 24 in 8.28 seconds, and UI typecheck/lint passed. Inspected 390/1440 light/dark Chromium layout fixtures composed with the real resolved app/Coding CSS: no horizontal overflow and 44px phone controls. Those static markup fixtures qualify copy wrapping only; they are not full-app, live PTY, real broker, native shell or physical-device evidence. No terminal protocol, authority, credential custody or endpoint capability changed; existing explanatory prose remains accurate.

Existing coverage and browser-smoke guidance remains accurate; presence and classification are not execution qualification.
